resources.string: The core runs in system_server. Target apps do not need to be added to the LSPosed scope.
Master switch. When disabled, OPlus mini-window support checks and foreground/cleanup protection are not modified.
Automatically loads the new Engine after an APK update. Bootstrap Hook structure changes still require one reboot.
The current Bootstrap does not support hot reload. Reboot the phone once.
Failed to synchronize the hot-reload request.
Apps are launched, minimized, restored, and closed entirely by OxygenOS. YMiniGuard only observes OPlus mini-window state.
Selected apps are kept running only while they are in a real OPlus FlexibleWindow, edge/minimized mini-window, or that mini-window is on the lock screen. Normal full-screen state is not modified.
When a selected app leaves normal full-screen mode for the launcher, another app, or the lock screen, it enters BACKGROUND_PROTECTED. Protection is removed automatically when you return.
Only selected apps bypass OPlus FlexibleWindow support/blacklist checks. YMiniGuard does not launch or switch an app into mini-window mode.
Mini-window protection remains driven by OPlus state. Background-playback apps enter BACKGROUND_PROTECTED only after leaving normal full-screen mode.
Keep protected process state at TOP
Returns TOP for real OPlus mini-windows, edge/lock-screen mini-windows, and BACKGROUND_PROTECTED processes.
Treat protected tasks as having a resumed Activity
Returns true for real OPlus mini-window and BACKGROUND_PROTECTED tasks. Normal foreground tasks are unchanged.
Block system cleanup of protected processes
Protects OPlus mini-window and BACKGROUND_PROTECTED processes. Force-stop and updates are allowed, and normal background tasks can still close when removed from Recents.
Records OPlus FlexibleWindow callbacks, support checks, task state, foreground queries, and OEM cleanup paths.

When selected, only the app's OPlus FlexibleWindow support/blacklist checks are bypassed. OxygenOS still launches the app and enters mini-window mode itself.

When selected, the app enters BACKGROUND_PROTECTED after leaving normal full-screen mode for the launcher, another app, or the lock screen. In-app navigation, finishing Activities, force-stop, and real closure are not intercepted.
When selected, YMiniGuard keeps the app foreground and playing only while it is actually in an OPlus mini-window, edge mini-window, or lock-screen mini-window. Normal full-screen state is untouched.
